meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 用户上报 LazyCodex/Codex 相关 bug 时,Claude 会复现并核对源码,选定归属的 GitHub 仓库,然后产出带根因、复现步骤与修复建议的 issue;仅在 openai/codex 仓库才可创建 PR。
howto.when: 当用户要求报告、提交或分流 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等的 bug 时;尤其在需要根因、复现步骤、修复指引和 GitHub 路由时。

say.text: 帮我上报一个 LazyCodex 安装器的 bug:安装后找不到命令。
say.note: Claude 会复现并创建对应仓库的 issue。

say.text: 给 openai/codex 提交一个 bug:审批通过后命令仍被拒绝。
say.note: Claude 会核对上游源码,确认归属再处理。

say.text: 分流一下:这个 bug 是 Codex 插件还是 LazyCodex 本体的?
say.note: Claude 会先收集运行时证据,判断属哪个仓库。

howto.what_en: When asked to report/triage a LazyCodex or Codex CLI bug, Claude reproduces it, checks sources, chooses the owning repo, and creates an English issue (PR only for openai/codex) with root cause, repro, and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, Codex plugins, or upstream Codex CLI, especially when they need root cause, repro steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

say_en.text: Please file a LazyCodex installer bug: command missing after install.
say_en.note: Claude reproduces and files an issue in the owning repo.

say_en.text: Report an openai/codex bug: still denied after approval.
say_en.note: Claude checks upstream sources before filing.

say_en.text: Triage this: is it the Codex plugin or LazyCodex itself?
say_en.note: Claude gathers evidence and points you to the right repo.
